name: Bollinger-style Fibonacci ratio bands (1.618/2.618/4.236)
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Bands = SMA(20) +/- ratio x stdev for ratios 1.618, 2.618, 4.236; entry buy when price reaches the selected upper/lower Fibo band per fiboBuy/fiboSell inputs (default Fibo 1 targets); optional Reverse Buy flips direction.
exit: Opposite band signal reverses (strategy.entry Buy/Sell only).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Exact buy/sell triggers are selected by input strings; stop-and-reverse; no stop.
